title: Iteration of the decoding state
statement: For every binary word $w$ and every natural number $j$, iterating the decoding step $j$ times from the state for $w$ at count zero gives the state for $w$ at count $j$.
replaced: For every binary target $w$ and count $j$, iterating the decoding step $j$ times from the initial state yields exactly the decoding state at $(w, j)$.
